content: 2025/2026 consensus production FastAPI Docker pattern: multi-stage build (builder stage compiles wheels/build-essential, runtime stage is python:3.11-slim without build tools), non-root USER, HEALTHCHECK. Process manager debate: Gunicorn+UvicornWorker is the general 'don't run uvicorn raw in prod' recommendation for multi-core hosts (workers = 2*cores+1), but this assumes at least 1 full CPU core is available.
